children: Norway's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose to 4.5% in August 2026 from an eighteen-month low of 4.2% in the previous month.
The number of unemployed persons increased to 138 thousand from 128 thousand in July.
The youth unemployment rate, which covers those aged 15 to 24, was up to 13.6% from 12.0%.
Meanwhile, the employment rate edged down to 69.8% in August from 70.2% in the previous month, with the number of employed persons decreasing to 2.926 million from 2.943 million.
The labor force participation rate inched lower to 73.1% from 73.3%, with the labor force reducing by 7 thousand from a month earlier to 3.064 million.
Total man-weeks worked, adjusted to a 37.5-hour workweek, advanced to 2.232 million from 2.199 million in the prior period.
Compared with August last year, the jobless rate was 0.4 percentage point higher at 4.9%.

title: Norway Jobless Rate Rises in August
